Due to HF max size of 10000 files per folder, this dataset does not contain all of the data based on my calculation it contains around 90% of the original data. 

	
		
		StanfordOnlineProducts (Image Retrieval)
	

This repository contains the raw images for the StanfordOnlineProducts dataset, formatted for use with Dino v3 retrieval applications.

	
		
		Usage in Frontend
	

You can access these images directly via the Hugging Face resolve endpoint:… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/pawlo2013/StanfordOnlineProducts.
